description: Make the model picker show the REAL capabilities and cost (no more uniform 'streaming · tools · vision · json · free' on every model), keep non-chat models out of the chat list, mirror the new/changed DTO fields into the TS types + every vitest mock/fixture, and update the architecture spec. Depends on FEAT-002 (the backend now emits real caps/price/quality and a filtered model list). This is the frontend + docs closeout.
steps: In frontend/src/types/index.ts, mirror any DTO change FEAT-002 made: if `AvailableModel` gained a `quality` field, add `quality: number` (camelCase, matching the Rust serde key) to the `AvailableModel` interface with a doc comment; if `ModelInfo`/`Capabilities` gained fields that cross IPC, mirror those too. Keep every field camelCase to match #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]. Do NOT invent fields the backend does not emit - confirm against FEAT-002's findings.

In frontend/src/features/model-selector/ProviderModelPicker.tsx: the display functions `capabilityLabels` and `priceHint` already read from `model.capabilities`/`model.price`, so once the backend sends real values they render truthfully - VERIFY they need no change beyond correctness. The chat list already excludes non-chat models because FEAT-002 filters them out of enumeration; confirm no frontend filter needs relaxing. Optionally surface the quality tier as a small hint label if a `quality` field was added (keep it compact, e.g. a tier word), but do NOT over-scope.

Because `isLocal` defaults to the zero-price heuristic (isFreeModel), verify that FEAT-002's nonzero cloud pricing now correctly routes cloud models into the 'Cloud' group and keeps genuinely-local (zero-price) models in 'Local'. Add/adjust a picker test asserting a nonzero-priced Gemini model renders under Cloud with a real '$in/$out per Mtok' price hint and its real capability labels (not the uniform set), and a zero-price local model renders under Local as 'free'.

AUDIT EVERY vitest test that mocks `invoke` for `list_available_models` (and any command returning AvailableModel/Capabilities/TokenPrice shapes): update the mock return fixtures to the NEW shape - real per-model capabilities (varied, not all-true), nonzero cloud price, zero local price, and the new `quality` field if added. Search frontend/src for mocks of list_available_models, get_route_explanation, and any AvailableModel fixtures. Every test mounting <App/>/chat/Settings must mock invoke for ALL commands with well-formed shapes; a missing/legacy field will break tsc or the assertions.
Ensure assertions after state changes use `await findBy*`/`waitFor` (existing pattern in the suite); do not introduce sync getBy after an async store update.

Update .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/architecture.md Section 6 (Routing Policy Engine): document (a) that enumeration filters the chat candidate pool to chat-capable models via the provider's real capability signal (Gemini's supportedGenerationMethods, with a name-family backstop) so non-chat model families are excluded from routing/picker; (b) the real per-model capability detection replacing uniform stamping; (c) the cost model - bundled representative defaults per ProviderKind seeded then overlaid by user-editable AppConfig rates, local = zero/'free' and cloud = nonzero-by-default; (d) the per-model quality tier feeding quality-for-complexity so Auto/Prefer-Quality differentiate models; (e) the 404/unavailable handling (ranking toward current models + verbatim error surface, and the fallback hop if implemented). Keep the prose consistent with Section 6.2's existing pricing paragraph.

From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run the REAL prettier over the WHOLE dir: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and fix any formatting so it is clean (do not eyeball). If node_modules is present, also run `npm run test`, `npm run lint`, and `npm run build` (tsc) and make them green; if offline prevents npm, hand-audit tsc-visible type sync and record it.

Prettier-check the edited Markdown spec too (it is under the repo, but the whole-frontend prettier only covers frontend/; verify the spec edit does not break any repo-wide format gate - if CI prettier covers .md, keep it tidy).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/types/index.ts mirrors every FEAT-002 DTO change (e.g. AvailableModel.quality) in camelCase, with no invented fields.

The picker renders REAL per-model capability labels and a truthful price hint (nonzero '$in/$out per Mtok' for cloud, 'free' for local), proven by an updated picker test; non-chat models never appear in the chat list.

Every vitest mock/fixture returning AvailableModel/Capabilities/TokenPrice is updated to the new shape (varied caps, nonzero cloud price, zero local price, quality field if added) and the suite is consistent.
architecture.md Section 6 documents the enumeration filtering, real capability detection, cost + quality model, and 404 handling.
`NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` is clean over the whole frontend dir; if runnable, `npm run test`/`npm run lint`/`npm run build` are green.
verification: From hybrid-orchestrator/frontend run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` and confirm exit 0.

If node_modules is available, run `npm run test` and `npm run build` (tsc) and confirm the picker test + full suite pass and types compile; otherwise document the hand-audit of type/fixture sync in findings.
Re-read the architecture.md Section 6 edits and confirm they describe the filtering, capability detection, cost, quality, and 404 behavior actually implemented in FEAT-002.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED the frontend + docs closeout on feat/real-auto-routing. tsc/vitest/eslint are CI-ONLY in this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox (node_modules absent, npm registry 403 per FEAT-001), so TS type + fixture sync was done BY HAND; the one runnable frontend gate `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` (prettier 3.9.6, node at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin) is CLEAN over the whole frontend dir.

== TYPE MIRROR (types/index.ts) ==
Added EXACTLY ONE field to the TS `AvailableModel` interface: `quality: number` (camelCase JSON key `quality`), with a doc comment mirroring the Rust field (0.0..=1.0, per-family/per-kind tier map, feeds quality-for-complexity, #[serde(default)] => older payload decodes to 0). Did NOT touch ModelInfo/Capabilities/TokenPrice per FEAT-002's handoff (ModelInfo's new `capabilities` is internal-only and does NOT cross IPC). No invented fields.

== PICKER (ProviderModelPicker.tsx) ==
VERIFIED no code change needed: `capabilityLabels` reads model.capabilities (streaming/tools/vision/jsonMode/maxContext) and `priceHint` reads model.price, so both render truthfully once real values arrive; `isLocal` defaults to the zero-price heuristic (isFreeModel), so FEAT-002's nonzero cloud pricing now correctly files cloud models under 'Cloud' and keeps zero-price local under 'Local'. Deliberately did NOT surface the quality tier as a label (kept minimal per 'do NOT over-scope'). Confirmed no frontend filter needs relaxing (non-chat models are already excluded at enumeration by FEAT-002).

== FIXTURE AUDIT (every AvailableModel construction site) ==
Added `quality` to ALL SIX object-literal AvailableModel fixtures across the suite: state/providers.test.ts (0.6), features/agent-editor/agent-editor.test.tsx (0.9), features/chat/attachmentContext.test.ts (0.6), features/chat/chat.test.tsx (local?0.5:0.9; visionModel spreads base so covered), features/model-selector/model-selector.test.tsx base `model()` (local?0.5:0.9) plus a NEW `geminiModel()` helper. app.test.tsx / settings.test.tsx / ipc/commands.test.ts return empty `models: []` arrays (no per-row field needed). Every test mounting <App/>/chat/Settings mocks invoke for all commands with well-formed shapes (unchanged; only per-row shape enriched).

== NEW PICKER TEST (the key acceptance proof) ==
Added model-selector.test.tsx test: a nonzero-priced Gemini pro model (vision+tools+json, 1000000 ctx, quality 0.9) renders under Cloud with the REAL '$1.25/$5 per Mtok' hint and its REAL multimodal capability labels; a lean flash-lite Gemini model (no vision/tools/json) renders under Cloud with DIFFERENT/narrower labels (proving caps are per-model, not the old uniform 'streaming · tools · vision · json' stamp); a zero-price ollama-local model renders under Local as 'free' and never under Cloud. Assertions are synchronous getBy on a directly-rendered component (no async store update in this test); the existing async store-driven tests already use findBy*/waitFor and were left intact.

== SPEC (architecture.md Section 6) ==
Added Section 6.5 'Feeding the policy real signal' documenting: (a) candidate-pool filtering to chat-capable models via Gemini supportedGenerationMethods + name-family backstop; (b) real per-model capability detection replacing uniform stamping; (c) the cost model (bundled representative per-ProviderKind defaults seeded then overlaid by user AppConfig rates; local=zero/'free', cloud=nonzero-by-default; consistent with 6.2's pricing paragraph incl. the stale-pricing caveat); (d) the per-model quality tier blended into quality_for_complexity so Auto/Prefer-Quality differentiate; (e) 404/unavailable handling (rank toward current models + verbatim MessageError surface; enumeration-time deprecation filter not applied for lack of a reliable Gemini marker; fallback hop deferred). 14-line addition, no reflow of surrounding content.

== PRETTIER ==
`NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend => 'All matched files use Prettier code style!' (exit 0). The edited architecture.md was ALREADY prettier-nonconforming on the untouched base (pre-existing table-alignment issues; verified via git stash) and there is NO repo-wide .md prettier gate (CI is green on main), so I did NOT run prettier --write on it (that would have reformatted 116 unrelated pre-existing lines); my 14-line prose addition is itself prettier-conformant. No em dashes introduced anywhere.

== NOT VERIFIABLE IN-SANDBOX (CI gate) ==
tsc/vitest/eslint cannot run offline. Hand-audit basis for first-try CI green: the TS change is a single required-field addition to one interface, and every literal that constructs that interface in the suite now sets it, so tsc's excess/missing-property checks are satisfied; the new test only uses APIs already imported in the file (render/screen/within/vi + ProviderModelPicker). Did not regress the thinking toggle, chat affordances, or enumeration (no non-test source touched beyond the type mirror).
